# devhelm_secret_value (Resource)

Sets a secret's value in one environment. The value is write-only (Terraform 1.11+): it is never stored in the plan or the state. Change `value_version` to write a new value. The secret key itself is a `devhelm_secret`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "devhelm_secret" "card_token" {
  key   = "CARD_TOKEN"
  value = var.card_token_default
}

# Per-environment value. `value` is write-only (Terraform 1.11+): it never
# enters the plan or the state. Bump `value_version` to write a new value.
resource "devhelm_secret_value" "card_token_production" {
  key            = devhelm_secret.card_token.key
  environment_id = devhelm_environment.production.id
  value          = var.card_token_production
  value_version  = "2026-10-25"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `environment_id` (String) Environment that receives this value
- `key` (String) Secret key, e.g. devhelm_secret.card_token.key
- `value` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret value for this environment; write-only, never stored in state

### Optional

- `value_version` (String) Any string; change it to write `value` again (write-only values aren't compared)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<key>/<environment_id>`
- `updated_at` (String) When this environment value was last written (RFC 3339)
- `updated_by` (String) Who last wrote this environment value

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by `<key>/<environment_id>`. Set `value` in configuration and bump
# `value_version` to overwrite what's stored.
terraform import devhelm_secret_value.card_token_production CARD_TOKEN/9f1c2d3e-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
```
